text:
ana: Quick sync — final PR for the pricing calculator + FAQ updates before tomorrow's deploy. Need decisions on: monthly vs annualized default, committed badge behavior, CTA copy for webinar, and lead routing thresholds.

sam: For conversion, show monthly by default and an annual toggle with savings calc. keep numbers simple.

leila: I added copy suggestions in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pricing-copy. My preference: label as 'Estimated monthly cost' and then small gray line 'annualized: $X/year' when toggled. Less legal-y.

ira: Design can implement the toggle + compact view. Quick question — do we pre-fill the committed discount on the enterprise tier? that will change the shown estimate a lot.

ben: Analytics note: showing a 'Committed' badge increases demo requests by ~18% in last test. It also increases median estimated MRR reported. Suggest we surface committed pricing but annotate with tooltip: "Committed rates shown; actual bill may vary with usage."

ana: @ben good call. Also need FAQ update #4 (billing) to mention reserved capacity vs metered usage. Leila — can you patch that entry with a short paragraph and a link to docs?

leila: Draft for FAQ: "Invoices include reserved capacity fees (monthly) + metered usage billed monthly. Overages beyond reserved capacity are charged at metered rates; see our billing docs for examples." I'll push this to the FAQ doc and ping for approval.

sam: Routing: when calculator estimates > $10k/mo send to sales+AE queue (tag: high-estimate). <= $10k go to SDR nurture flow. Anyone opposed?

ira: No objections. I'll add hidden fields to the form payload: estimated_monthly, committed_flag, plan_slug. This lets Sales filter without manual math.

ana: Webinar CTA — can we add a small inline CTA under the calculator: "See full cost breakdown — join our 30m webinar". We want to A/B test text: Version A: 'Join our 30m webinar: cost breakdown' Version B: 'See pricing explained in 30m — sign up'. Track with utm=pricing_calc_webinar.

leila: I'll draft both CTA variants. Suggest short supporting line: "Live Q&A on optimizing unit cost."

sam: Also add tracking event 'pricing_calc_cta_click' with properties {estimate, committed_flag, variant}.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: pricing-calc-updates -> staging at 2024-11-02T02:00:00Z.

ana: Great — please land the FAQ change + tracking by EOD. I'll approve PR if tests are green. Thanks everyone.

sam: Adding follow-up: we should set analytics alert if demo leads from calc > 2% of visitors — flag me.

ben: I'll add the alert and a dashboard card for 'Calculator conversions' with breakdown by estimate bucket.
